description: This PHP source file defines the `Aws\JsonCompiler` class, which loads JSON files and compiles them into PHP arrays, primarily used internally within the AWS SDK for PHP.

classes.name: JsonCompiler
classes.description: A class responsible for loading and compiling JSON files into PHP arrays, primarily utilized internally within AWS SDK for PHP. It includes a method to load JSON data from cache or from the original JSON file.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a JSON file from cache or directly from the JSON file via the `load_compiled_json` function.
